title: Take in the Network Theme Kit design system: every one of its 200 files is claimed, the gaps are listed

source.ref: Daniel, 2026-10-28: program the new Network design system into the theme system the way Nocturne is. Plan: /mnt/project-files/network-theme/PLAN.html

verify.evidence: Fails on main (no docs/design-systems/network) and passes here.

detail: Pass 0 of 12. The new Network is its own Theme Kit (code id network-kit, shown as Network); the old network theme that The Group runs stays untouched until its staged move in the last pass. docs/design-systems/network holds the rules (every file claimed, the sales page and Nocturne-era chrome marked as not shipped), the inventory, the token and copy captures, and the baseline of known gaps, which can only shrink. scripts/design-system.test.ts reads each theme's token block from a table. Later passes build against the baseline.
